FetchedBlob.description: A fetched blob from the relay.

mailbox_token.description:
Mailbox token the blob arrived for. Returned to the recipient (who already knows token→contact via local registration) so the receive loop can route in O(1) instead of brute-forcing every contact's ratchet. Privacy-neutral: the relay already has the token, the recipient computed it locally.

`None` for older relays that have not deployed this field; clients fall back to brute-force routing.

origin_hint.description: Base64-encoded opaque origin-device hint the sender attached (see [`V2SendRequest::origin_hint`]). Returned verbatim so the receiver can resolve the sender device before decrypting. `None` for blobs sent by older clients or relayed by older relays.

V2GuardianDeleteRequest.description:
V2 guardian delete request body.

Deletes all guardian entries for a hash (identity purge).

designator_pk.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 designator public key (64 hex chars). The relay requires `SHA-256(designator_pk || "guardians") == guardian_hash`, proving the caller owns the identity the hash derives from.

guardian_hash.description: Hex-encoded guardian hash to delete (64 hex chars = 32 bytes).

signature.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 signature (128 hex chars) over `domain || designator_pk || guardian_hash || timestamp_be`.

timestamp.description: Unix seconds; the relay rejects requests outside ±60s.

V2GuardianEntry.description:
A single encrypted guardian entry (opaque to the relay).

Each entry is a sealed-box encrypted guardian token. The relay cannot read contents, identify guardians, or learn anything beyond the entry count.

data.description: Base64-encoded encrypted blob (sealed-box: ephemeral X25519 + XChaCha20-Poly1305).

guardian_hash.description: Hex-encoded guardian hash to look up (64 hex chars = 32 bytes).

V2GuardianStoreRequest.description:
V2 guardian store request body.

Atomically replaces all guardian entries for a given hash. Removing a guardian = re-upload without their entry.

designator_pk.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 designator public key (64 hex chars). The relay requires `SHA-256(designator_pk || "guardians") == guardian_hash`, proving the caller owns the identity the hash derives from.

guardian_hash.description: Hex-encoded hash of `designator_pk || "guardians"` (64 hex chars = 32 bytes).

signature.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 signature (128 hex chars) over `domain || designator_pk || guardian_hash || timestamp_be`.

timestamp.description: Unix seconds; the relay rejects requests outside ±60s.

V2PurgeRequest.description: V2 purge request body: an Ed25519 signature over `public_key || purge_token || timestamp`. It names no mailbox; the relay erases the one addressed by `public_key`, since a body-chosen mailbox let any key pair empty any mailbox whose token it held (#944).

erase_guardian_set.description: Also erase the guardian set at `SHA-256(public_key || "guardians")`. Covered by the signature; absent means keep it, which is all an old client could ask for.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp (must be within 60s of server time).

V2RecoveryProof.description: A single recovery proof entry in a query response.

V2RecoveryQueryRequest.description: V2 recovery proof query request body.

key_hashes.description: Hex-encoded key hashes to look up (max 50).

V2RecoveryStoreRequest.description: V2 recovery proof store request body.

key_hash.description: Hex-encoded hash of the old public key (32 bytes = 64 hex chars).

owner_pk.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 public key of the identity uploading the proof, so its purge can erase the proof. Proofs without an owner expire.

proof_data.description: Base64-encoded recovery proof data (opaque to relay, max 4 KiB).

signature.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 signature by `owner_pk` over the upload.

timestamp.description: Unix seconds, signed with the owner key.

V2RegisterRequest.description: V2 register mailbox tokens request body.

blobs_deleted.description: Number of blobs deleted by a purge request.

guardians.description: Guardian entries returned by a query.

proofs.description: Recovery proofs returned by a query.

truncated.description: `true` when `/v2/fetch` capped this page under the OHTTP forward limit and more blobs remain; the client re-fetches after ACK-removing this page. Absent/false on responses that returned everything.

origin_hint.description:
Base64-encoded opaque origin-device hint (`nonce || AEAD(sender_device_id)`, encrypted to the recipient). Lets the receiver select the sender's device-pair ratchet without the transport learning the sender edge.

`None` for older clients that predate this field; the receiver then falls back to the legacy `[0;32]` sender-device path. The relay stores and returns it verbatim, never inspecting it.

description: The JSON bodies of the relay's /v2 requests and responses, generated from vauchi-protocol's types by its wire_schema_tests. Length and item bounds are the parser's; a longer value is refused before any handler runs. Fields not listed are accepted and ignored, as the parser does. Charsets (hex, base64) are documented, not enforced at the parse boundary.
